definitions.explanation: Something that is not final or permanent but serves as a placeholder or stopgap until a proper arrangement is made.
Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or assumption, often in the pattern {仮|かり}に〜としても.

examples.japanese: {仮|かり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I gave it a tentative name.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{仮|かり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧しれません。
examples.english: It's still a tentative schedule, so it may change.

examples.japanese: {仮|かり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住|す}まい→住まい：11555_sumai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦{暮|く}らした→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I lived in temporary housing for half a year.

examples.japanese: {仮|かり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧そうだ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Even supposing that were the case, there would be no problem.
Hypothetically, if he doesn't come, what will we do?

examples.japanese: {仮|かり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{百万円|ひゃくまんえん}⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{買|か}えない→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: Even if you hypothetically had one million yen, you couldn't buy this house.

notes:
Modifies nouns directly as {仮|かり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (temporary ~). In sense 2, used adverbially as {仮|かり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ at the start of a sentence to introduce a hypothesis. The kanji {仮|かり} also appears in many compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仮|かり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (disguised form, temporary appearance)
- ⟦{仮|かり}{住|ず}まい→仮住まい：16492_karizumai⟧ (temporary dwelling)
- {仮|かり}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧ (provisional license, learner's permit)
- {仮|かり}⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧ (tentative setting)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {仮|かり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even supposing that ~)
- {仮|かり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜たら (hypothetically, if ~)
